BigInt/BigUint implementation refinement, GCD, Barrett, Toom and NTT algorithms

Structural facts, certificates, intervals and explicit uncertainty
Caches, atomics, concurrency, unsafe memory, cancellation and resources

Complete production source and dependency coverage audit
